processing: Native integer window col=3646, row=3630, width=500, height=500; centre from IAU Shackleton position snapped to source grid.
40 km projected square selected to include crater and surrounding rim terrain. No reprojection, upsampling, interpolation, merging or scaling.
Preserved valid float32 source elevations exactly; source NaN/masked cells map to finite float32-min NoData. Valid zero preserved.
Preview: existing backend render_rgba/encode_png, 2-98 percentile display stretch and hillshade (azimuth 315 degrees, altitude 45 degrees). Actual DEM pixels, transparent invalid cells.
limitations: 80 m projected spacing is not effective resolution; see auxiliary EFFRES statistics.
Upstream DEM gridding/interpolation is inherited; no observation mask supplied.
Crop includes the south pole; longitude wraps and is undefined at the pole. Use projected bounds and CRS rather than a naive geographic rectangle.
Current backend only registers Mars and enforces Mars radius; moon elevation limits are absent.
Current preprocessing rejects raster centres with absolute latitude above 89 degrees; Shackleton needs a separately reviewed polar compatibility change.
